item.title: Plan for daily driving snow leopard in 2026
item.description: I think a lot of Apple fans would agree with me that Apple has somewhat lost its way with recent Mac OS releases. Now I’m not a complete liquid glass hater, I actually quite enjoy the effect on iOS, I think it works well there, but that’s all it is – just an effect. Apple seemingly went on about how this was a revolutionary change to their design and I agree it is cool but wow did it end up being underwhelming.
